title: Optimal Solution
description: Contains the optimization result and execution statistics.

best_value.description: Maximum achievable score/value under given constraints.

explored_nodes.description: Number of search nodes explored during optimization.

optimality_gap.description: Relative optimality gap ((Upper Bound - Best Value) / Best Value). 0.0 if proven optimal.

status.description: Indicates whether the solution is mathematically optimal or an approximation.

strategy_used.description: The actual search strategy employed during optimization (records whether `Pure` or `Heuristic` was chosen under `Mixed` mode).

top_candidates.description: Optional list of top-ranked alternative solutions (Ranked 1st to K-th).

upper_bound.description: Theoretical upper bound on the objective value (Dual bound).

CandidateSolution.title: Candidate Solution
CandidateSolution.description: Represents an alternative feasible configuration among the top candidates.

SolutionStatus.title: Solution Optimality Status
SolutionStatus.description: Indicates whether the returned solution is proven optimal, an approximation, or bounded due to time/resource limits.

oneOf.description: Mathematically proven optimal solution (all branches explored and pruned).
Feasible approximation or incumbent solution obtained before full convergence (e.g., reached timeout limit, node limit, or generated by primal heuristics).

SolverStrategy.title: Solver Optimization Strategy
SolverStrategy.description: Execution mode controlling the search and optimization algorithm.

oneOf.description: Automatically selects the faster strategy (`Pure` vs. `Heuristic`) based on problem size and constraint density (default).
Exact branch-and-bound search without graph-based structural heuristics.
Branch-and-bound search guided by structural heuristics, leveraging constraint graph embeddings and a greedy strategy for an initial warm start.
